en_title: Another Modder Uses AI to Make a Multiplayer Mode for The Last of Us Part 2 — Will Sony Shut This One Down, Too?
cn_title: 又一位模组制作者利用AI为《最后生还者 第二部》制作多人模式——索尼也会叫停这个模组吗？
opus_summary: 模组作者Kellie借助生成式AI，为PC版《最后生还者 第二部 复刻版》制作了免费多人模组《Twelve Weeks》。此前另一款多人模组曾收到索尼的停止侵权函。Kellie表示，新模组已免费开源，即使被叫停，索尼也无能为力。

paragraphs.en: Another modder has used AI to make a multiplayer mode for The Last of Us Part 2 , insisting there isn't much Sony can do about it "even if they do shut me down."
paragraphs.cn: 又一位模组制作者利用AI为《最后生还者 第二部》制作了多人模式，并坚称索尼对此无能为力，「即使他们真的叫停我的项目」。

paragraphs.en: The Last of Us had a brilliant multiplayer mode, with tense gunfights powered by weapon sway, smart cover, and nail-biting in-round crafting that forced you to dig around in your backpack as bullets whizzed over your bonce.
paragraphs.cn: 《最后生还者》有一个出色的多人模式，武器晃动、巧妙的掩体运用以及令人紧张的对局内制作系统，共同造就了紧张的枪战；在制作物品时，你不得不在子弹从头顶呼啸而过的同时翻找背包。

paragraphs.en: That’s why so many people were excited when Naughty Dog announced a Factions multiplayer game in the works based on The Last of Us Part 2 . Naughty Dog, however, eventually realized that making a live-service game would change the studio forever, and cancelled the project to focus instead on its upcoming sci-fi game, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet .
paragraphs.cn: 这就是为什么顽皮狗宣布正在开发一款基于《最后生还者 第二部》的Factions多人游戏时，那么多人感到兴奋。然而，顽皮狗最终意识到，制作一款长线运营游戏会永远改变工作室，于是取消了该项目，转而专注于即将推出的科幻游戏《星际：异端先知》。

paragraphs.en: The Last of Us Part 2 made some brilliant tweaks to the combat, allowing for better mobility and deeper stealth. The feel of the weapons, the crunch of the impacts, the audiovisual spectacle of it all was just something else, but we can only experience it in single-player, officially.
paragraphs.cn: 《最后生还者 第二部》对战斗做了一些出色的调整，让移动更加灵活，潜行也更有深度。武器的手感、击中时的脆响，以及这一切带来的视听盛宴，都令人赞叹，但通过官方渠道，我们只能在单人游戏中体验这些。

paragraphs.en: It’s no wonder people want to make Factions happen, even without Sony’s approval. And in September, a promising mod made some big strides towards getting multiplayer working in The Last of Us Part 2. As soon as it started to get traction, however, the mod was sent a cease and desist letter from Sony . “Hey everyone, as you all know, the TLOU 2 Multiplayer mod that has been in development since January was supposed to [be released] this month,” wrote creator 'Speclizer' at the time.
paragraphs.cn: 难怪人们想要实现Factions，即使没有索尼的许可也是如此。去年9月，一款前景可期的模组在让《最后生还者 第二部》的多人模式运作起来方面取得了重大进展。然而，这款模组刚开始受到关注，就收到了索尼发来的停止侵权函。制作者「Speclizer」当时写道：「大家好，正如大家所知，从1月开始开发的《最后生还者 第二部》多人模组原本应该在本月［发布］。」

paragraphs.en: “Unfortunately I recently received a letter on behalf of Sony Interactive Entertainment requesting for the mod not to be released. Extremely sad that this never got to see the light of day but I hope you’ll continue to follow me onto the next project, this time something of my own.”
paragraphs.cn: 「不幸的是，我最近收到了一封代表索尼互动娱乐发来的信，要求不要发布这款模组。它最终没能面世，我感到非常难过，但我希望大家继续关注我的下一个项目，这次将是我自己的作品。」

paragraphs.en: Now there’s a new mod hoping to avoid the eye of Sauron, and it’s already out. The mod is called Twelve Weeks and was built specifically for The Last of Us Part 2 Remastered on PC, using, its creator has admitted, generative AI. Modder 'Kellie' admitted to using Claude code for most of the game's development, and AI was even used to write the lore dumps you can find in the game. The art was, however, made using Blender .
paragraphs.cn: 现在，一款希望避开索伦之眼的新模组已经推出。这款模组名为《Twelve Weeks》，专为PC版《最后生还者 第二部 重制版》打造，其制作者承认使用了生成式AI。模组制作者「Kellie」承认，游戏的大部分开发工作都使用了Claude Code，甚至连游戏中可以找到的大段背景设定文字也是用AI撰写的。不过，美术内容是使用Blender制作的。

paragraphs.en: The Last of Us returns with a new online multiplayer mode called TWELVE WEEKS created for The Last of Us Part 2 Remastered on PC. This free mod is a work in progress allowing players to experience a new version of the beloved Factions multiplayer with tactical survival gameplay https://t.co/2P8Wv4abQb
paragraphs.cn: 《最后生还者》以全新在线多人模式《TWELVE WEEKS》回归，该模式专为PC版《最后生还者 第二部 重制版》打造。这款免费模组仍在开发中，让玩家能够体验备受喜爱的Factions多人模式的新版本，其中包含战术生存玩法https://t.co/2P8Wv4abQb

paragraphs.en: It features reworked levels — Supply Raid and Interrogation for now — with team-based 4v4 combat, new weapons, and character customization. Players can use gadgets like molotovs and smoke bombs, while fighting against other players as the WLF and Seraphites. The mod even adds brutal execution moves. You can grab Twelve Weeks on Nexus Mods .
paragraphs.cn: 它包含重新制作的关卡——目前有Supply Raid和Interrogation——以及团队制4v4战斗、新武器和角色自定义功能。玩家可以使用燃烧瓶和烟雾弹等道具，扮演WLF和疤脸帮与其他玩家战斗。该模组甚至加入了残酷的处决动作。你可以在Nexus Mods上获取《Twelve Weeks》。

paragraphs.en: However, the mod probably won't last long. The modders have attempted to cover their backs with a repository disclaimer that said: "Twelve Weeks is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Sony Interactive Entertainment or Naughty Dog. The Last of Us is a trademark of its owners. You need your own legitimately purchased copy of the game (Steam). This repository contains no game files and no assets taken from the game."
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这款模组可能不会存在太久。模组制作者试图通过代码仓库中的免责声明保护自己，声明称：「《Twelve Weeks》是一个非官方粉丝项目。它与索尼互动娱乐或顽皮狗没有关联，也未得到其认可或赞助。《最后生还者》是其所有者的商标。你需要自己合法购买一份游戏（Steam）。本代码仓库不包含任何游戏文件或取自游戏的素材。」

paragraphs.en: Will Sony take action? In a reply to someone on YouTube , Kellie said the previous Factions mod got hit by Sony because it was paywalled. "Mine is released already for free and in open source," they said. "Since people have the source code to the full mod already, there ain't much they can do even if they do shut me down."
paragraphs.cn: 索尼会采取行动吗？Kellie在YouTube上回复某人时表示，之前的Factions模组遭到索尼打击是因为它设置了付费门槛。「我的模组已经免费发布，而且是开源的，」他们说，「既然人们已经拿到了完整模组的源代码，即使他们真的叫停我的项目，也无能为力。」

paragraphs.en: While The Last of Us Online was canceled, there are hints that Naughty Dog may be ready to return to the series for The Last of Us 3 . And then there is HBO's The Last of Us TV series , which is currently shooting its third (and likely last) season.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然《最后生还者Online》已被取消，但有迹象表明，顽皮狗可能正准备重返该系列，开发《最后生还者3》。此外，HBO的电视剧《最后生还者》目前正在拍摄第三季，这也可能是最后一季。
